description: Defines an abstract base class 'FrameSerializer' for serializing and deserializing 'Frame' objects in the Pipecat project. It provides an interface with setup, serialize, and deserialize methods that subclasses must implement to handle frame serialization logic.

classes.name: FrameSerializer
classes.description: Abstract base class for frame serialization implementations, specifying the interface for serializing and deserializing Frame objects.

methods.name: setup(self, frame: StartFrame)
methods.description: Initializes the serializer with startup configuration using a StartFrame object.

methods.name: str|bytes|None serialize(self, frame: Frame)
methods.description: Converts a Frame object into a serialized format (string, bytes, or None).

methods.name: Frame|None deserialize(self, data: str | bytes)
methods.description: Converts serialized data back into a Frame object.

ctags.name: deserialize
ctags.pattern: /^    async def deserialize(self, data: str | bytes) -> Frame | None:$/

ctags.name: serialize
ctags.pattern: /^    async def serialize(self, frame: Frame) -> str | bytes | None:$/
